meta.title: Horizon, a Digimon World mod
meta.description: A new story, Digimon from three other games, 60 fps and a new translation for Digimon World on the PlayStation. Patch your own discs in the browser.
lang.label: Language
hero.title: The Digimon World you remember, and a lot more.
hero.lead: A new story, Digimon from three other games, 60 frames per second and a new translation. Built from your own discs, right here in the browser.
patcher.title: Patch your disc
patcher.lead: Add your four discs. They are checked here, on your computer; nothing is uploaded.
patcher.dropHint: Drop your discs to add them
patch.needSources: Add the three source game discs. Their models are converted here on your computer.
patch.ready: Ready. It takes a few minutes, here in your browser.
features.title: What's new
features.lead: Choose language, frame rate, font, difficulty, new Digimon, extended story and display settings in OPTIONS. Engine and bug fixes always apply.
community.title: Community
footer.legal: Horizon is a fan project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Bandai Namco or Toei Animation; Digimon is their trademark. This page holds no game data: you need your own discs, and they never leave your computer.
patch.building: Building your disc in this browser. Keep this tab open.
build.howTo: Keep both files in the same folder and open the .cue in your emulator (DuckStation, PCSX-Redux...).

problems.title: Some files cannot be used
why.stillChecking: {other} ({game}) was still being checked. Add this one again when it has finished, if you want it instead.
why.badDump: It looks like {game}, but it is not the original dump: a modified, damaged or differently ripped image (its checksum does not match).
why.isoDw1: A 2048-byte .iso of Digimon World drops its movies and voices, so the patched game would break.
why.unreadable: The file could not be read ({error}).
why.fanTranslation: This looks like a fan translation of Digimon World (a Japanese disc with its text changed by fans). Fan translations cannot be used: the patch is built on an original disc, and it brings translations of its own.
why.encrypted: The archive has a password. Unpack it yourself and add the .bin/.cue.
why.parts: Parts of this archive are missing. Add every part together (.part1.rar, .part2.rar… or .001, .002…).
why.archiveBroken: This archive cannot be opened. It may be damaged or not fully downloaded.
why.archiveError: The archive could not be unpacked ({error}).
why.emptyArchive: There is no disc image this page can use in this archive.
why.ecmChecksum: The ECM file is damaged: its checksum does not match.
why.pbpEncrypted: This PBP is encrypted (a PlayStation Store copy). Use the .bin/.cue of the disc.
why.pbpMulti: PBP files with several discs are not supported. Use the .bin/.cue of the disc.
why.notImage: This is not a disc image. Add the .bin (or the .bin and .cue together).
why.track: This is one audio track of a disc with several. Add the .cue together with all its .bin files.
why.chd: CHD files cannot be opened in the browser yet. Convert it to .bin/.cue with chdman: chdman extractcd -i game.chd -o game.cue
why.cueOnly: A .cue only points to the image. Add {file} together with it.
why.otherGame: This is another PlayStation game ({serial}), not one of the four this page uses.
works.us: What works for Digimon World: the redump .bin/.cue of the USA, European, French, German, Spanish, Italian or Japanese (Rev 1) disc.
works.dcb: What works for Digimon Digital Card Battle: the USA or European disc, or the Japanese Digital Card Arena.
works.dw2: What works for Digimon World 2: the USA or Japanese disc.
works.dw2003: World 2003 (Europe) and World 3 (Japan) work. World 3 (USA) is unsupported.
